question: If in a code language, LIST is written as 48 and GUILT is written as 66, then how will PROSE be written in the same language?
solution:
The alphabets and their positions are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63298a47acd53b254b8ad8e2dd6978d33df89ad763097e5b89c5add127273f64.png] 

The logic here is:

For the word LIST is written as 48 and GUILT is written as 66 as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22ae95c3b8db5b91b6d098fdf942fa08d93d67a1b7a50a833527ab68d195c4e8.png] AND [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ed01d40c86eb7357e2d222626c2aad25f942f1a4839f86e81f514f0c5014b16.png] 

 

Similarly the code language for the word PROSE will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05c89da194760e03bed2e165d7d9fca1dd8159b2acc69f123f6065029edf3c00.png] 

Thus, the code language for the given word is **62**.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
